string-array.name: guide360_gopro_lines
string-array.item: # Before (once)
Connect the GoPro Quik app once to set the camera clock.
Turn GPS on: Preferences → Regional → GPS: On.
A fast memory card (V30), 128 GB or more.
Mode: 360 Video, 5.6K 30 fps.
# Mounting
On a pole, 30–50 cm above the helmet.
Upright: one lens forward, one backward.
Firmly, no wobble.
# Each ride
Turn the camera on; wait until the GPS icon stops blinking.
On the phone: Camera 360 → Start.
Start recording on the GoPro.
Hold the phone QR code to the camera for 2–3 seconds.
Ride at 20–30 km/h; slow down near signs.
End: show the QR code again, then stop recording.
# Back at the office
Copy the .360 files from the card.
Export them as 360 video in GoPro Player.
Send the exported files with the ride for processing.
# Tips
Wipe the lenses before each ride.
Take a break every 20–30 minutes so the camera does not overheat.
Ride both directions when you can: better positions.

string-array.name: guide360_theta_lines
string-array.item: # Each ride
Turn on the camera and its Wi-Fi.
Camera 360 → Camera control: Ricoh Theta.
Enter the serial (under the camera).
Tap Connect, pick the THETA network.
Start: the phone takes the photos and writes its GPS into each.
End → Save.
# Back at the office
Copy DCIM/100RICOH over USB.
Send the photos with the ride for processing.
# Notes
A Theta needs a few seconds per photo: ride slower or pick 12–20 m.
Theta X: turn its Wi-Fi on in the camera menu.
